subject: [PATCH] memcg: avoid charging the root memcg from obj_cgroup_charge_pages()

reviews.author: Farhad Alemi
reviews.summary: Farhad Alemi noted that the patched kernel no longer panics on a reproducer, indicating the patch is successful in avoiding charging the root memcg.
reviews.raw_body:
The patched kernel (this patch on 28924df2a08f) no longer panics on
the attached reproducer.


On Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 9:47 AM Johannes Weiner <hannes@cmpxchg.org> wrote:

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where the root memory cgroup (memcg) is being charged incorrectly when a task migrates from a child cgroup to the root cgroup. The problem occurs because the obj_cgroup_charge_pages() function resolves the object cgroup (objcg) to its memcg and calls try_charge_memcg(), which does not short circuit the root memcg. This leads to an asymmetric charge, where the root's page counter grows but is never uncharged. The patch uses try_charge() instead of try_charge_memcg(), which returns early for the root memcg and restores symmetry with obj_cgroup_uncharge_pages().
